 Alex Eala battles American Parks in HK Open first round
 Nov 4, 2026
 2:51 PM GMT+8
 Alex Eala (Photo from WTA website)
 MANILA – Filipino Alexandra Eala will face American Alycia Parks in the first round of the WTA 250 Prudential Hong Kong Open at Victoria Park Tennis Stadium on Tuesday.
 The world No. 19 Eala is the No. 2 seed in the event, which closes the 2026 tour-level season for additional players who did not qualify for the WTA Finals, slated Nov 8 to 15 in Indian Wells, United States.
 "I am super excited to be back. Playing here last year was amazing, the crowd, the hospitality, so I couldn't be happier to be back," Eala said at the pre-event press conference Monday.
 In 2025, Eala won 6-4, 2-1 (ret.) over British Katie Boulter, who quit due to a thigh injury, in the Round of 32, before bowing to Canadian Victoria Mboko, 6-3, 3-6, 4-6.
 Mboko went on to win the title after surviving Spanish Cristina Bucsa, 7-5, 6-7 (9), 6-2.
 Eala is coming off a 6-2, 6-7(5), 4-6 quarterfinal loss to Diana Shnaider at the WTA 500 Toray Pan Pacific Open in Tokyo, Japan last week.
 Shnaider, seeded third, eventually won the tournament, beating Canadian Leylah Fernandez, 6-4, 5-7, 6-2.
 Shnaider also beat Eala, 7-5, 6-4, in the Round of 16 at the Ningbo Open in China two weeks ago.
 After bagging the singles bronze medal at the Nagoya Asian Games on Oct. 1, Eala made early exits in China and Singapore.
 Seeded No. 13 at the WTA 1000 Wuhan Open, Eala fell to Chinese qualifier Shi Han, 6-4, 3-6, 3-6, in the first round.
 At the WTA 500 Singapore Open, the third-seeded Eala absorbed a shocking 4-6, 7-5, 3-6 first-round loss to World No. 180 Tatiana Prozorova. (Jean Malanum/PNA)
